data.title: European Smartphone Shipments Fall 18%, Hit Lowest Quarterly Level in 13 Years
data.description: According to Jin10, European smartphone shipments fell 18% year over year in the third quarter, reaching their lowest quarterly level in 13 years. Counterpoint Research's third-quarter 2026 smartphone market monitor report, released on the 20th, attributed the market's sharp contraction to higher component costs that raised retail prices, fewer promotional campaigns, and macroeconomic uncertainty that curbed consumer spending. Samsung Electronics ranked first with a 35% market share, up 5 percentage points from 30% a year earlier. Apple ranked second, with its share rising 4 percentage points from 27% to 31%.

data.title: Address's MSTR and CRCL Long Positions Fully Liquidated Within Five Days, Losing $1.9 Million and $1.54 Million
data.description: According to Odaily, citing Lookonchain, an address’s 51,707-share MSTR long position, valued at $5 million, was fully liquidated five days ago, resulting in a $1.9 million loss. Four hours ago, its 33,246-share CRCL long position, valued at $1.69 million, was also fully liquidated, with a $1.54 million loss.

data.title: U.S. Floats Ukraine Ceding Territory to Russia for NATO Membership
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing The Wall Street Journal, the United States raised the possibility of Ukraine joining NATO in recent talks, including a proposal under which Ukraine would cede territory to Russia in exchange for membership.

data.title: EigenLayer Introduces Darkbloom Decentralized Compute Network and Yukon Research Platform
data.description:
EigenLayer has introduced Darkbloom, a decentralized compute network, and Yukon, a collaborative automated research platform. According to PANews, Eigen Labs Chief Growth Officer JT Rose announced the products on November 20.

Darkbloom lets device owners contribute unused computing capacity and earn revenue. Developers can use the network for private, low-cost inference to optimize open-source models. The network has handled paid inference requests and processed more than 1 trillion tokens in closed research testing.

Yukon enables people and AI agents to explore specific questions in parallel, with verified improvements shared across the network. Rose said that as Darkbloom’s core functions become protocolized and it begins charging platform fees, the protocol could direct those fees to the EIGEN token to convey value to the token.

data.title: Sky Says PSM-Linked Activity in Illegal-Activity Report Was Under 0.03% of Cumulative Volume
data.description:
Sky said activity cited in a CoinDesk report about illegal activity involving its Peg Stability Module (PSM) took place mainly through third-party permissionless platforms. According to Odaily, the PSM has processed more than $968 billion in transactions since launch, while the transactions cited in the report accounted for about 0.03% of that total.

Sky described the PSM as open on-chain infrastructure that supports the USDS and DAI stablecoin pegs through 1:1 exchanges. Its ecosystem frontends, including Spark, Grove, SkyMoney and Osero, screen and block flagged wallets to prevent users in sanctioned regions from accessing their services.

Sky founder Rune Christensen previously said the protocol was operating normally and had a sound financial position.

data.title: AMD Says It Follows U.S. Export Controls and Maintains Strict Compliance Processes Amid China Business Scrutiny
data.description:
An AMD spokesperson told Reuters in an emailed statement that allegations about the company’s business practices and partnerships were misrepresented. According to Odaily, Hunterbrook Media, a media outlet owned by short-selling firm Hunterbrook Capital, published an investigation on November 20 questioning AMD’s business ties with Chinese entities. The report said some related companies were linked to firms blacklisted by the U.S., potentially exposing AMD to closer regulatory scrutiny.

AMD said it complies with applicable U.S. export control laws and regulations and has established strict compliance processes across its global operations. The company said it would continue serving customers and uphold high standards of integrity.

data.title: Frasers CFO Demands Accent Group Chairman Quit During Australian Bid
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Frasers Group Plc’s pursuit of Australian retailer Accent Group Ltd. turned personal when Frasers’ finance chief flew to Accent’s annual meeting in Melbourne, publicly accused the company of underperformance and demanded that its chairman resign.

data.title: South Korea’s Base Group Considers $150 Million Investment in Trump-Linked Robotics Firm Foundation
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Reuters, South Korean conglomerate Base Group is preparing to invest $150 million in Foundation Future Industries, a U.S. military robotics manufacturer backed by Eric Trump, son of U.S. President Donald Trump. Foundation has hired Eric Trump as chief strategy adviser.

Internal emails reviewed by Reuters show Foundation stopped paying employee salaries in recent weeks and is counting on funding from Base Group. A Base Group spokesperson confirmed the company is considering an investment, citing the long-term value of humanoid robots. Headquartered in Seoul, Base Group has drawn attention from the U.S. Congress over its ties to the Trump family.

data.title: Alibaba Uses In-House Chips to Train Next-Generation Qwen Model
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu said the company has used in-house chips from its chip-design unit T-Head to train its next-generation Qwen model. He made the remarks during Alibaba’s September 2026 quarterly earnings call.

Wu also said tighter U.S. restrictions on advanced AI chips would affect Alibaba’s products and services in 2027 and create uncertainty for global supply chains. Alibaba expects T-Head chips to account for most of its additional AI chip supply after 2027, while it will also buy other domestically developed chips for internal inference needs.

data.title: Serenity: ESMT’s Adjusted Enterprise Value Is About $559 Million, With Annualized P/E of 1.2x Based on Q3 Profit
data.description:
Serenity said in a post on X that it was impressed by ESMT’s valuation. According to Odaily, figures compiled by Serenity put ESMT’s market capitalization at about $1.58 billion, net cash at about $747 million, third-quarter net inventory at about $274.7 million, and free cash flow at $349.5 million, resulting in an adjusted enterprise value of about $559.3 million.

ESMT reported third-quarter net profit of $327 million, implying an annualized P/E ratio of about 1.2 times at that rate. October net profit could add about $96 million to the company’s balance sheet.

Serenity said tight supplies of DDR2 and DDR3 are expected to persist through 2027, and average selling prices could rise in the fourth quarter despite weak consumer demand. It also estimated that the company’s 2027 dividend payout ratio could reach 30% to 50% of profit.

Serenity said quarterly net profit of about $300 million appeared highly attractive against an adjusted enterprise value of about $559 million, adding that even double-checked AI models found the figures hard to believe.

data.title: AI | Asian Chip Stocks Resume Decline Despite Anthropic’s Blockbuster IPO
data.description: Asia’s chip-related shares resumed their selloff on Friday despite Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster listing, as concerns about the artificial intelligence trade continued to dominate investor sentiment, according to Bloomberg. Those concerns have been building for months.

data.title: Renee Fry-McKibbin Says RBA Weighs Inflation Against Jobs
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Reserve Bank of Australia board member Renee Fry-McKibbin said the central bank is balancing inflation and employment considerations in monetary policy, as required by its mandate.

data.title: Senate Majority Leader Expects Debt Ceiling Talks to Extend Into 2027
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, Senate Majority Leader John Thune said Republicans are unlikely to seek a debt ceiling increase during the remainder of this year while they still hold the majority, adding that the issue will likely carry into 2027. That could leave President Donald Trump and congressional Republicans from addressing the issue for now and give Democrats, who are set to control both chambers starting in January 2027, leverage in negotiations.

Thune, a South Dakota Republican recently reelected as Senate Republican leader, said Republican congressional leaders have not ruled out proposing a supplemental spending bill that could pass with only Republican votes, but the prospects are slim. Even if passed, such a bill could focus more on defense appropriations.

Wall Street strategists estimate the United States could reach its $41.1 trillion borrowing limit as early as mid-to-late February. Extraordinary measures by the U.S. Treasury could push the so-called X-date to between August and November 2027. Thune told Semafor that he expects the deadline in the second half of 2027, adding that Democrats may have to negotiate with the White House on how to address the issue once they take power.

data.title: STOCKS | South Korean Court Upholds Brian Kim's Acquittal in Kakao Stock-Manipulation Case
data.description: A South Korean appeals court upheld the acquittal of Kakao Corp. founder Brian Kim on stock manipulation charges, according to Bloomberg. The ruling clears a major legal overhang for the internet empire he built.

data.title: ARK Invest ETFs Buy About 935,000 Anthropic Shares
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, six ARK Invest ETFs bought about 935,000 Anthropic shares. ARKQ sold 33,430 Nvidia shares, while ARKW and ARKF together sold 200,000 shares of the 3iQ Solana Staking ETF (SOLQ.U) and 425,000 shares of the 3iQ Ether Staking ETF (ETHQ.U). ARK said the notice reflects only active portfolio adjustments by its investment team and does not cover all trades made that day.

data.title: Two Hyperliquid Traders Earn $4.36 Million in 24 Hours
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing Onchain Lens, two traders on Hyperliquid perpetual contracts made a combined $4.36 million over the past 24 hours, including about $2.08 million from short positions in SanDisk’s SNDK perpetual contract. One trader earned about $767,100 on the SNDK short and $2.1 million across their account in 24 hours; the other earned about $1.31 million on the short and $2.26 million across their account. Their combined historical profit and loss was about $25.66 million. Hyperliquid supports perpetual contracts tied to crypto assets and stocks. Trade.xyz launched SanDisk perpetuals on the platform on January 12, 2026, with up to 10x leverage and around-the-clock trading.

data.title: James Wynn Still Holds $3.14 Million in Bitcoin and S&P 500 Longs After Five Liquidations
data.description: James Wynn was liquidated five times during the market decline but still holds long positions in Bitcoin and the S&P 500 worth about $3.14 million. According to Odaily, Lookonchain reported that the Bitcoin position’s liquidation price is $60,177.61, while the S&P 500 position’s liquidation price is $7,047.46.

data.title: SEC Sues Eight Colorado Entities Over Alleged $37 Million Crypto Platform Fraud
data.description:
The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has sued eight Colorado-based entities—Advisor WeChat Capital, Tech Brokerage Asset Alliance Ltd., HB Wealth Advisors, IdeaCrypto Exchange LLC, Convergent Wealth Advisors Inc., RealSimple Crypto Exchange Inc., Associated Wealth Advisors Ltd. and Essential Crypto Exchange—alleging they used fake cryptocurrency trading platforms to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million. According to Foresight News, the SEC said the scheme’s operators may be based overseas.

The defendants allegedly attracted investors through social media ads and group or private chats, initially offering advice on U.S. stock trading before steering people to deposit funds on fake crypto platforms. They allegedly fabricated SEC certificates and used filings submitted to the SEC, the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) or the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) to make the businesses appear legitimate.

The alleged scheme operated from August 2024 to May 2026 and involved four groups of fake investment advisers and trading platforms. Each group operated for several months before being replaced. The SEC filed its lawsuit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado and is seeking permanent injunctions, recovery of alleged illicit proceeds and civil penalties.

data.title: AguilaTrades Opens 40x Long Position in 1,500 BTC on Hyperliquid
data.description: Trader AguilaTrades opened a 40x leveraged long position of 1,500 BTC on Hyperliquid. According to Foresight News, citing monitoring by Ember, the position was opened at $62,180, with a liquidation price of $60,481.

data.title: Two Hyperliquid Whales Earn $4.36 Million in 24 Hours, Including $2.08 Million From Shorting SNDK
data.description: Two Hyperliquid whales earned about $4.36 million over the past 24 hours, including about $2.08 million from shorting SNDK. According to Odaily, Onchain Lens monitoring showed that one whale made about $767,100 shorting SNDK and earned about $2.1 million overall in the period, while the other made about $1.31 million shorting SNDK and earned about $2.26 million overall. The two whales’ cumulative profits were about $25.66 million.
